title: Senior Analyst (QA, US Healthcare)
description:
**Our Story**

At Alight, we believe a company’s success starts with its people. Alight embraces values that come directly from our people – purposeful, human, united and growth-minded – reflecting our inclusive culture and promise that our clients expect. We are passionate about connecting purpose with impact. Alight empowers clients to build a healthier and more financially secure workforce by unifying the benefits ecosystem across health, wealth, wellbeing, navigation, and absence management.

**Our Benefits**

With a comprehensive total rewards package, Alight offers programs and plans that support your mind, body, wallet, and life. Benefits include health, starting Day One. Additionally, Alight colleagues enjoy wellbeing programs, retirement plans, and career growth opportunities – all within a thriving global organization.

**Great Place to Work**

Thanks to the work of every colleague, Alight has received multiple awards of recognition including “Great Place to Work” for the past 7 years and Fortune’s “Best Companies to Work For.” To learn more about our company culture and awards **Click Here.**

We invite you to join our team! Learn more at careers.alight.com.

**Designation: Senior Analyst**

**Key Expectations:**

* **Own execution, timeliness, and quality of analysis and testing activities within assigned projects.**
* **Deliver high-quality test plans, test cases, and test execution aligned to client and system requirements.**
* **Apply deep domain and technical expertise to ensure quality-driven outcomes.**
* **Mentor team members and contribute to capability and capacity building within the team.**
* **Collaborate effectively with clients, development teams, and stakeholders to ensure successful delivery.**

**Required Skills:**

* **Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.**
* **Expertise in system testing, QA methodologies, and test documentation (test plans, reports, metrics).**
* **Strong stakeholder communication and customer responsiveness.**
* **Ability to work independently and collaboratively under tight deadlines.**
* **Coaching and mentoring skills to guide junior team members.**
* **Strong understanding of US Benefits administration – Health & Welfare domain**
* **Deep understanding of Files landscape – Vendor, Payroll files, 834, Non-834 files**

**Soft-Skills:**

* **Attention to detail and quality ownership mindset**
* **Ability to work in distributed/onshore–offshore teams**
* **Proactive issue identification and risk escalation**
* **Adaptability to change client needs and agile delivery environments**
* **Customer**‑**centric approach and empathy for end users**

**Role Description:**

**The Senior Analyst – Technology is responsible for the execution, quality, and timely delivery of analysis and testing activities within assigned projects. The role includes requirement analysis, test case design, test planning, system testing, defect analysis, and reporting test results for systems developed by the engineering team.**

**The role requires deep files and domain expertise, along with strong analytical and interpersonal skills. The Senior Analyst works closely with clients and their vendors, reviews and validates requirements and technical specifications, and ensures test coverage accurately reflects system capabilities and business needs.**

**The incumbent plays a critical mentoring role—guiding junior analysts, supporting skill development, and contributing to capacity building initiatives. The role also involves identifying process improvements, supporting UAT, and ensuring quality standards are consistently met across deliverables.**

**Technical & Domain Expertise:**

* **JIRA**
* **Expert in CBA tools, strong database knowledge (CBA)**
* **UAT support and production validation**
* **SQL queries for business validation**
* **Understanding of Health & Welfare services**

**Education:**

* **B.Tech (CS / IT / ECE) or MCA – mandatory Experience**
* **Prior experience with Alight / Aon / Wipro is an added advantage**
* **Health or Retirement Domain experience preferred**

**Application and Interview**

By applying for a position with Alight, you understand that, should you be made an offer, it will be contingent on your undergoing and successfully completing a background check consistent with Alight’s employment policies. Background checks may include some or all the following based on the nature of the position: Government ID validation, education verification, employment verification, and criminal check, search against global sanctions and government watch lists, credit check, and/or drug test. You will be notified during the hiring process which checks are required by the position.

Alight requires all virtual interviews to be conducted on video. Please be aware that Alight is a camera-on culture and may require occasional travel to one of our physical office locations.

**Our commitment to Inclusion**

We celebrate differences and believe in fostering an environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and supported. We know that diverse teams are stronger, more innovative, and more successful.

At Alight, we welcome and embrace all individuals, regardless of their background, and are dedicated to creating a culture that enables every employee to thrive. Join us in building a brighter, more inclusive future.

As part of this commitment, Alight will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation for the hiring process. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact alightcareers@alight.com.

**Equal Opportunity Policy Statement**

Alight is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not discriminate against anyone based on sex, race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital or domestic partner status, citizenship, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristics or conduct covered by federal, state, or local law. In addition, we take affirmative action to employ disabled persons, disabled veterans, and other covered veterans.

Alight provides reasonable accommodation to the known limitations of otherwise qualified employees and applicants for employment with disabilities and sincerely held religious beliefs, practices and observances, unless doing so would result in undue hardship. Applicants for employment may request reasonable accommodations/modifications by contacting their recruiter.

**Authorization to work in the Employing Country**

Applicants for employment in the country in which they are applying (Employing Country) must have work authorization that does not, now or in the future, require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the Employing Country and with Alight.

Note, this job description does not restrict management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities of this job to other entities; including but not limited to subsidiaries, partners, or purchasers of Alight business units.

We offer you a competitive total rewards package, continuing education & training, and tremendous potential with a growing worldwide organization.

**DISCLAIMER:**

Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities of this job to other entities; including but not limited to subsidiaries, partners, or purchasers of Alight business units.

title: QA Tester
description:
QA Tester

Location: On -site

Experience: 1–2 Years

Employment Type: Full-Time

Role Overview

We are looking for a QA Tester to ensure the quality and reliability of our AI-powered applications, intelligent agents, analytics dashboards, and Lakehouse-based data solutions. You will work closely with developers, data engineers, and solution architects to validate functionality, data accuracy, and overall system performance.

Key Responsibilities

* Execute functional, regression, integration, and UAT testing.
* Test AI agent workflows, APIs, dashboards, and analytics platforms.
* Validate data quality and reporting accuracy across Lakehouse environments.
* Log, track, and verify defects through resolution.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams during development and release cycles.
* Support test automation initiatives where applicable.

Required Skills

* 1–3 years of experience in Software Testing/QA.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, and Agile methodologies.
* Experience with API testing tools such as Postman.
* Basic SQL knowledge for data validation.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Skills

* Exposure to AI/ML or Generative AI applications.
* Understanding of Lakehouse, Databricks, Snowflake, or similar analytics platforms.
* Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright, or Cypress.

What You'll Work On

* AI Agents & Automation Solutions
* Analytics Dashboards & Reporting
* Data Validation & Quality Assurance
* Lakehouse-Based Data Platforms
* API Integrations & Enterprise Applications

Pay: ₹200,000.00 - ₹250,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: QA Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

This is a QA Engineer role on our Quality Engineering team. You'll be embedded directly alongside a product development pod, owning quality outcomes for that surface area; manual testing and automation are not separate functions here; you'll do both.

You'll report to the QA Engineering Manager and work closely with developers, product managers, and your pod as a real partner in shipping quality software, not a downstream checkpoint.

AI tooling has changed what QA can do day-to-day. We expect you to actively use agentic tools like Claude Code, Kiro, or Codex to help generate and maintain tests. You don't need to have architected pipelines from scratch, but you should be comfortable using these tools as part of your daily workflow.

**What You'll Own**

**Your Pod**

● Serve as the QA owner for your dev pod, test strategy, automation coverage, and quality sign-off for your team's features

● Grow your automation depth and agentic tooling fluency over time

● Take ownership incrementally as you build trust and track record

**Quality Execution**

● Write and maintain test cases across manual and automated coverage for your pod's features

● Help ensure shift-left practices, automation coverage, and clear quality gates are part of the definition of done

● Surface quality risks to your dev team and PM early before code ships, not after

● Track relevant quality metrics for your area: defect leakage, escaped defects, automation coverage, regression stability

**AI-Assisted QA Engineering**

● Use agentic tools (Claude Code, Kiro, Codex, or similar) to help generate test cases, triage CI failures, and maintain regression suites

● Validate AI-generated test output for correctness you're responsible for what ships, even when a tool helped write it

● Bring ideas back to the team on ways AI tooling can speed up testing work

**Automation & Execution**

● Contribute to test plans, sprint readiness, and release sign-off for your area

● Flag capacity risks and blockers early

**Who You Are**

**Must Have**

● **2–4 years of experience in QA or Quality Engineering**, ideally in a fast-moving SaaS product environment (daily/weekly/bi-weekly releases)

● Hands-on experience using AI coding/testing assistants (Claude Code, Copilot, Kiro, Codex, or similar) in your day-to-day work

● Solid coding ability- you can read, write, and reason about code, and contribute to or review test automation frameworks

● Experience with both manual testing and test automation– comfortable moving between the two

● **Backend automation** - hands-on experience building and maintaining API and service-level test automation (REST APIs, databases, messaging) and running it in CI/CD pipelines

● **Web automation**- hands-on experience building and maintaining UI test automation for web applications (Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar) and running it in CI/CD pipelines

● Strong communication and partnership instincts with developers and PMs

● Familiarity with shift-left practices- thinking about quality early in the dev cycle

● Comfort with ambiguity - able to take a fuzzy quality goal and turn it into concrete test coverage

**Strong Plus**

● Exposure to agentic QA workflows - self-healing tests, AI-generated regression suites, automated triage

● Background or interest in AppSec or security tooling (SAST, DAST, SCA, integrations)

● Experience testing AI features - understanding of prompting, output validation, hallucination risks

● Experience working in a pod or squad model with embedded QA

**Why You Will Love It**

● Career Growth Opportunities: we promote from within and provide clear progression paths

● Work-Life Balance: flexible hours and hybrid work options

● Collaborative Environment: a culture where people learn from each other

● Employee Recognition: awards, employee of the month programs, and more

● Competitive Compensation: competitive salaries and performance-based bonuses

● Comprehensive Benefits: health insurance for employees and dependents, plus learning and upskilling support

● Diversity and Inclusion: a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered

Join ArmorCode and help build the safest software possible.

**Equal Opportunity**

ArmorCode is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or any other legally protected category. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration for employment regardless of their background or characteristics.

Apply or share CV on +918076502497, info@creativesera.com

Pay: ₹316,000.00 - ₹1,390,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person
